provider: radar4kit (kit) — 600 gb per dataset, but kit-members only

free_tier.stated: Free of charge for KIT members; the usable size of temporary storage and of permanent storage for archived and published data packages is capped by a per-employee quota set in the KIT standard IT configuration (the quota figure is unverified: that page answers only from inside the KIT network); the archive system limits each dataset to 600 GB, and 50 to 100 GB per dataset is the recommended size.

per_object_cap.stated: 600 GB per dataset, the maximum set by the archive system; 50 to 100 GB per dataset is advised for reuse
per_object_cap.notes: the cap applies to one dataset (data package); very large data can be split across several linked datasets

retention.stated: Archived data packages: the data provider sets a retention period and KIT guarantees at least 10 years; published data packages: at least 25 years; data packages in temporary storage are deleted after six months unless archived or published
retention.notes: temporary storage holds a data package for six months at most; permanent storage is tape, read asynchronously

interface_detail: web user interface, REST API, and WebDAV: data can be uploaded and organized via a WebDAV client without an active session, then imported into a data package

identity_cost.detail: Upload needs a workspace that the KIT Library sets up for a KIT institute, research group or project team, and the service is free for KIT members. Login takes a KIT employee account, another institutional account or a registered RADAR user account; sub-curator rights can be granted to people outside KIT.

reliability_note: Upload needs a workspace set up by the KIT Library and a KIT account login (non-KIT accounts only in special cases); a data package in temporary storage is deleted after six months; permanent storage is tape, with retrieval taking several minutes and in exceptional cases hours.
